summary: Tested expanded RSI bounds (20/80 vs 25/60) on BNB/USDT - WFA completed 57/57 windows with OOS Sharpe 1.4205 (+11.4% vs source 1.275), max DD improved to -7.89%. Hypothesis that extreme bounds outperform was NOT validated - optimizer consistently selected 25/60.

key_lessons.lesson: Extreme RSI bounds (20/80) did not outperform standard 25/60
key_lessons.specific_finding: Optimizer explored 20/80 but selected 25/60 - same as source run. Hypothesis that 'trend toward extremes continues' was falsified.

key_lessons.lesson: BNB achieves best-ever EMA Trend Gate result in this run
key_lessons.specific_finding: OOS Sharpe 1.4205 exceeds prior BNB runs: source (1.275), IDEA-923409-1zj (0.6636), and prior live run (0.432). However, this contradicts earlier finding that BNB was worst-performing asset.

key_lessons.lesson: Win rate consistently near 50% across BNB experiments
key_lessons.specific_finding: 49.44% win rate here vs 49.79% source - indicates limited edge per trade, strategy relies on risk/reward asymmetry rather than accuracy.
